purpose.summary: A batch IMS/DLI subprogram (routing routine) that handles ISRT, DLET, and REPL DLI commands. It initialises working areas, sets up the IMS PCB pointer, dispatches to the appropriate DLI operation based on an operation code, and manages error/abend handling. The program is a template/skeleton with the actual command dispatch replaced by a placeholder (#OPE#).
